records.strength_gate: V67 explicitly adds adequate strength; do not infer all later occurrences inherit the same condition
records.observables: Where income originates; possibly multiple sources
records.negative_control: Having a certain occupation without earning from the stated person/source is a miss, not a hit
records.notes: Do not infer house lord from planets physically located in house; no chart scoring

records.scientific_ethics: Historical moral/ethical allegations NOT scored against people or used to infer crimes. The source offers a mixed case, not two independent scores for mixed occupancy.
records.negative_control: Amount of money says nothing directly about whether it was acquired through the source's claimed means

records.positive_condition: 2nd/11th lords friendly to Lagna lord -> source prescribes beneficial disposal of wealth
records.negative_condition: weak/defeated/debilitated or otherwise unfavorable eleventh occupant -> historical need/begging claim
records.gate: Do not collapse disposition of money and whether money is possessed. Technical strength, graha-yuddha, Dusthana and Reḵā-yoga requirements need exact definition before any synthetic astronomy.
records.negative_control: Ordinary charitable donations do not validate claims of impoverishment; ordinary low income is not equivalent to begging

records.contrast: XV.67-68 describe occupants; XV.71 explicitly describes who OWNS/ rules eleventh, even when the planet is located elsewhere.
records.caste_bias: Original uses historical derogatory occupational classes for Saturn; do not classify modern livelihoods or people as ignoble.
records.negative_control: Saturn occupying eleventh cannot be substituted for Saturn being lord of eleventh; they may be different planets

records.lineage: Comparable classical teaching or shared formula; Sanskrit lexical identity is NOT established, direction of transmission unknown
records.negative_control: Cannot count JP gain as independent empirical replication, and cannot dismiss contradictory SC loss after seeing a person's income

records.contrast: JP XV.64 negative-slander claim has malefic tenth/aspect and weak tenth lord; SC tenth v24 on 1929 Sanskrit plate has positive satkīrti where Bhasin English translates negative. These predicates overlap in theme but are NOT identical, so JP cannot force an editorial correction of SC.

records.resolution: Archive catalog dates 1922, external annotation says 1932/33, printing's actual imprint/title leaf NOT visually verified; refer to item SHA and printed pages, not an independently proved imprint date
records.numbering: Printed XV.60/61 corresponds to VedicPupil /verse-59/60 when checked. VedicPupil chapter page currently omits printed 72–74; cached deprecated URL snippets are not a verified additional exact verse-number crosswalk.
records.negative_control: A stale snippet, redirect or different route is not evidence of a globally fixed +1 or -1 mapping

provenance_policy: Textual coincidences are not independent forecast confirmations; cross-work semantic similarities need own explicit dependency family; do not infer moral character or criminality from natal planets.
next_frontier: Original Sanskrit critical collation of SC eleventh v2 vs v10 and JP XV.72 with documented alternative readings; complete physical-to-online 15th chapter local verse map; under-sampled primary texts (Jaimini / Saravali / Portuguese Parashara) with true negatives and input gates; no biography leakage.
